title: Service Advisor
description:
Role - Service Advisor / Service Receptionist

Location - Chester

Salary - £30,000 Basic Salary £38,000 Realistic OTE Overtime Available

1 in 4 Saturday Mornings

Richard Abson Group is delighted to be assisting a prestigious automotive dealership in Chester in their search for an experienced Service Advisor / Service Receptionist.

Representing one of the industry's leading premium brands, this dealership forms part of a highly respected dealer group renowned for investing in its people. You'll benefit from ongoing manufacturer training, genuine career progression, and the opportunity to work within a modern, forward-thinking business embracing the latest hybrid and electric vehicle technology.

As the first point of contact for customers, you'll play a key role in delivering an exceptional aftersales experience. You'll manage service bookings, provide vehicle progress updates, explain technical information in a customer-friendly manner, and identify opportunities to promote service plans and additional aftersales products.

Working Hours:
- Monday to Friday, 8am-6pm
- 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, paid at overtime

What we're looking for:
- Minimum of 1 year's experience as a Service Advisor or in a similar aftersales role within a franchised main dealership
- A passion for delivering outstanding customer service with a proactive sales approach
- Experience using Kerridge and 1 Link would be advantageous, although not essential
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- A professional and customer-focused approach

Salary & Benefits:
- £30,000 basic salary
- £38,000 realistic OTE
- Uncapped bonus opportunities, including hours sold, service plans and upsell/cross-sell performance
- Current team members are consistently exceeding their bonus targets
- 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, paid at overtime
- Manufacturer training and genuine career progression
- Opportunity to work with the latest hybrid and electric vehicle technology

If you're an experienced Service Advisor or Service Receptionist looking to join a premium main dealership that genuinely invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Part Time Payroll Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Payroll Assistant

Location: Northwich
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Permanent, Part-Time
Hours: 15 or 22.5 hours per week, over 2 or 3 days

We are currently recruiting for a Part-Time Payroll Assistant to join an established and growing professional services business in Northwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who already has some payroll experience and is looking to broaden their knowledge, take on more responsibility and develop their career within payroll. You'll join a supportive and experienced payroll team, with plenty of opportunity to learn and develop your skills across a varied client base.

The Role

Working as part of the payroll team, you will assist with the accurate and timely processing of payrolls for a diverse portfolio of clients. This will include weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies across a range of sectors.

You will work closely with experienced payroll professionals, giving you the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, gain exposure to different payroll requirements and build your confidence in dealing with clients and payroll queries.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the preparation and processing of payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Process payroll information accurately and ensure deadlines are met.
- Support with payroll administration, including Auto Enrolment and BACS processing.
- Respond to routine payroll queries from clients, colleagues, HMRC and other third parties.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records.
- Assist with resolving payroll issues and escalate more complex queries when required.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation and statutory requirements.
- Build strong and professional relationships with clients.
- Work collaboratively with the wider payroll team.
- Contribute to improving payroll processes and delivering a high level of client service.

About You

We're looking for someone with some previous payroll experience who is keen to develop and expand their skill set.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience working in a payroll role.
- A good understanding of basic payroll processes and statutory requirements.
- Some knowledge of Auto Enrolment and statutory payments.
- Experience using payroll software; BrightPay experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Good communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- A positive attitude and genuine interest in developing a career in payroll.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Experience within a payroll bureau or accountancy practice would be advantageous, but candidates from an in-house payroll background will also be considered.

Why Join?

You'll be joining a supportive team where you can continue to develop your payroll experience while working with a varied client portfolio. The role offers flexibility and could suit someone looking to balance their career with other commitments.

Benefits include:
- 36 days' holiday including Bank Holidays and Christmas period (full-time equivalent)
- 5% employer pension contribution
- Option to buy or sell up to 5 days' holiday
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Life Assurance
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental pay
- Enhanced sick pay
- Referral scheme
- Paid volunteer time
- Long-service enhancements to pension contributions and holiday entitlement
- On-site parking
- Team social events
- Free fruit

Hours & Flexibility

This is a permanent part-time position, with flexibility around working hours.

Applications are welcomed from candidates looking to work either:
- 15 hours per week over 2 days, or
- 22.5 hours per week over 3 days
